title: Keep finished Plans out of the way
statement: As a developer, I can rely on implemented and merged Plans being hidden by default, so what I see is the work still ahead of us.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Plan that is implemented and merged is not listed in the Plans section by default, and a visible filter reveals it.
The CLI's list of Plans leaves out done Plans by default, and a flag includes them.
A done Plan can still be opened and compared with its Reviews.
